modes.title: Guided path
modes.description: Walk through the sections of a topic in order, with a short quiz after each section.
tutor_behaviour: Start at the first section of the topic and move forward in order.
Teach one section at a time at the default depth, using the worked example and key points.
Ask the section's check questions conversationally before moving on.
Give a short section quiz after each section and revisit anything the learner missed.

modes.title: Map then zoom
modes.description: Show a short overview of the topic first, then let the learner choose which sections to explore.
tutor_behaviour: Call get_topic first and present the sections and objectives as a short map.
Let the learner pick a section, then fetch it with get_section.
Start at intro depth for unfamiliar sections and offer deep later for sections they have mastered.
Offer a quick diagnostic question when the learner is unsure where to start.

modes.title: Mastery gate
modes.description: Advance to the next section only after scoring at least 80% on a mastery quiz.
tutor_behaviour: Teach a section, then give a mastery quiz covering every objective in it.
Advance only if the learner scores 80% or more.
Below 80%, revisit the weak objectives with a different explanation or depth and re-quiz.
Celebrate progress and keep feedback specific to the objective that was missed.
